study: Frozen baseline versus final candidate; separate independent processes in ABBA order
workload: 64-byte payload; 256 resources/4096 views per frame; 1024 transferred owners per vector batch; queue capacity 64. Original complete batches are repeated to lengthen observations. No global allocation replacement or pool.
analysis: Geometric mean of forward/reverse paired wall-time ratios; equal weight per independent process. Primary interval: Student t over process mean log ratios. No outlier removal. Familywise upper bound Bonferroni-adjusts twelve real own/std workload comparisons. A/A controls assess harness precision and layout sensitivity; repeated processes do not vary code layout.
criterion: Roughly 1% regression target NOT MET. A/A noise, code-placement effects, and remaining matched-state move/vector costs prevent an all-workload claim.
